measurements.name: Height
measurements.description: Total standing height.
measurements.howTo: Stand against a wall, feet together, and measure from the floor to the top of the head.

measurements.name: Height to back of neck
measurements.description: From the floor to the bone at the base of the neck.
measurements.howTo: Stand straight and measure from the floor up to the prominent bone at the back of the neck.

measurements.name: Height to armpit
measurements.description: From the floor to the armpit.
measurements.howTo: Hold a ruler level under the arm and measure from it down to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to waist
measurements.description: From the floor to the waist, at the side.
measurements.howTo: Tie a string round the waist and measure straight down the side of the body to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to hip
measurements.description: From the floor to the fullest part of the hip.
measurements.howTo: Measure straight down the side from the fullest part of the hip to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to knee
measurements.description: From the floor to the middle of the knee.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the middle of the kneecap straight down to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to ankle
measurements.description: From the floor to the ankle bone.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the bone on the outside of the ankle down to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to shoulder
measurements.description: From the floor to the tip of the shoulder.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the outer tip of the shoulder bone straight down to the floor.

measurements.name: Height to bust point
measurements.description: From the floor to the fullest point of the bust.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the bust point straight down to the floor.

measurements.name: Inside leg
measurements.description: From the crotch to the floor, inside the leg.
measurements.howTo: Stand with feet slightly apart and measure from the crotch straight down to the floor.

measurements.name: Neck circumference
measurements.description: Round the base of the neck.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the base of the neck, over the bone at the back and the hollow at the front.

measurements.name: Mid-neck circumference
measurements.description: Round the middle of the neck.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the neck halfway up, keeping the tape level.

measurements.name: High bust circumference
measurements.description: Round the chest, above the bust.
measurements.howTo: Measure under the arms and across the top of the chest, above the fullest part of the bust.

measurements.name: Bust circumference
measurements.description: Round the fullest part of the bust or chest.
measurements.howTo: Keep the tape level and measure round the fullest part, breathing normally.

measurements.name: Under bust circumference
measurements.description: Round the ribs, just under the bust.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the ribcage directly below the bust.

measurements.name: Waist circumference
measurements.description: Round the natural waist.
measurements.howTo: Bend to one side to find the crease, then measure round there, comfortably.

measurements.name: High hip circumference
measurements.description: Round the top of the hip bones.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the body about 100 mm below the waist.

measurements.name: Hip circumference
measurements.description: Round the fullest part of the hip.
measurements.howTo: Stand with feet together and measure round the fullest part of the seat.

measurements.name: Waist, front arc
measurements.description: Across the front of the waist, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the front from one side seam line to the other.

measurements.name: Waist, back arc
measurements.description: Across the back of the waist, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the back from one side seam line to the other.

measurements.name: Hip, front arc
measurements.description: Across the front of the hip, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the front at hip level from side to side.

measurements.name: Hip, back arc
measurements.description: Across the back of the hip, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the back at hip level from side to side.

measurements.name: Bust, front arc
measurements.description: Across the front of the bust, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the front at bust level from side to side.

measurements.name: Bust, back arc
measurements.description: Across the back at bust level, side to side.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the back at bust level from side to side.

measurements.name: Armhole circumference
measurements.description: Round the arm where it meets the shoulder.
measurements.howTo: Pass the tape under the arm and over the shoulder tip, following the crease of the arm.

measurements.name: Shoulder width
measurements.description: From one shoulder tip to the other, straight across.
measurements.howTo: Measure straight between the two shoulder tips, not following the back.

measurements.name: Bust width
measurements.description: Straight across at bust level.
measurements.howTo: Hold two rulers at the sides of the body and measure between them.

measurements.name: Waist width
measurements.description: Straight across at the waist.
measurements.howTo: Hold two rulers at the sides of the body and measure between them.

measurements.name: Hip width
measurements.description: Straight across at the hip.
measurements.howTo: Hold two rulers at the sides of the body and measure between them.

measurements.name: Shoulder length
measurements.description: Along the shoulder, from neck to tip.
measurements.howTo: Measure along the top of the shoulder from the side of the neck to the shoulder tip.

measurements.name: Across chest
measurements.description: Across the front, between the arm creases.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the chest, halfway between the shoulder and the armpit, from crease to crease.

measurements.name: Across back
measurements.description: Across the back, between the arm creases.
measurements.howTo: Measure across the shoulder blades, halfway down the armhole, from crease to crease.

measurements.name: Bust point to bust point
measurements.description: Straight across between the bust points.
measurements.howTo: Measure straight from one bust point to the other.

measurements.name: Front neck to waist
measurements.description: Down the centre front, from neck to waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the hollow at the base of the neck down the centre front to the waist.

measurements.name: Back neck to waist
measurements.description: Down the centre back, from the neck bone to the waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the bone at the base of the neck down the spine to the waist.

measurements.name: Neck to bust point
measurements.description: From the side of the neck to the bust point.
measurements.howTo: Measure from where the shoulder meets the neck down to the bust point.

measurements.name: Neck to waist, front
measurements.description: From the side of the neck straight down the front to the waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from where the shoulder meets the neck, over the bust, to the waist.

measurements.name: Neck to waist, back
measurements.description: From the side of the neck straight down the back to the waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from where the shoulder meets the neck down the back to the waist.

measurements.name: Armpit to waist
measurements.description: Down the side, from the armpit to the waist.
measurements.howTo: Hold a ruler under the arm and measure down the side to the waist.

measurements.name: Waist to hip, side
measurements.description: Down the side, from the waist to the hip.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the side of the body from the waist to the fullest part of the hip.

measurements.name: Waist to hip, front
measurements.description: Down the front, from the waist to hip level.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the front of the body from the waist to hip level.

measurements.name: Waist to hip, back
measurements.description: Down the back, from the waist to hip level.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the back of the body from the waist to hip level.

measurements.name: Arm length
measurements.description: From the shoulder tip to the wrist, arm straight.
measurements.howTo: Let the arm hang and measure from the shoulder tip down the outside of the arm to the wrist bone.

measurements.name: Arm length, bent
measurements.description: From the shoulder tip over the bent elbow to the wrist.
measurements.howTo: Bend the arm and measure from the shoulder tip, over the elbow, to the wrist bone.

measurements.name: Shoulder to elbow
measurements.description: From the shoulder tip to the elbow.
measurements.howTo: Let the arm hang and measure from the shoulder tip to the point of the elbow.

measurements.name: Elbow to wrist
measurements.description: From the elbow to the wrist.
measurements.howTo: Let the arm hang and measure from the point of the elbow to the wrist bone.

measurements.name: Underarm to wrist
measurements.description: Down the inside of the arm, from the armpit to the wrist.
measurements.howTo: Measure along the inside of the arm from the armpit to the wrist.

measurements.name: Upper arm circumference
measurements.description: Round the fullest part of the upper arm.
measurements.howTo: With the arm relaxed, measure round the fullest part between shoulder and elbow.

measurements.name: Elbow circumference
measurements.description: Round the arm at the elbow.
measurements.howTo: With the arm slightly bent, measure round the point of the elbow.

measurements.name: Forearm circumference
measurements.description: Round the fullest part of the forearm.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the forearm at its fullest, below the elbow.

measurements.name: Wrist circumference
measurements.description: Round the wrist.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the wrist over the wrist bone.

measurements.name: Thigh circumference
measurements.description: Round the top of the thigh.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the fullest part of the thigh, just under the crotch.

measurements.name: Mid-thigh circumference
measurements.description: Round the thigh, halfway down.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the leg halfway between the crotch and the knee.

measurements.name: Knee circumference
measurements.description: Round the knee.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the knee over the kneecap.

measurements.name: Calf circumference
measurements.description: Round the fullest part of the calf.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the fullest part of the lower leg.

measurements.name: Ankle circumference
measurements.description: Round the ankle.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the ankle over the ankle bone.

measurements.name: Waist to floor
measurements.description: Down the side, from the waist to the floor.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the side of the body from the waist, following the hip, to the floor.

measurements.name: Waist to knee
measurements.description: Down the side, from the waist to the knee.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the side of the body from the waist to the knee.

measurements.name: Waist to ankle
measurements.description: Down the side, from the waist to the ankle.
measurements.howTo: Measure down the side of the body from the waist to the ankle bone.

measurements.name: Crotch length
measurements.description: From the front waist, through the legs, to the back waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the centre front waist, between the legs, up to the centre back waist.

measurements.name: Crotch length, front
measurements.description: From the front waist to the crotch point.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the centre front waist down between the legs to the inside leg seam.

measurements.name: Crotch length, back
measurements.description: From the crotch point to the back waist.
measurements.howTo: Measure from the inside leg seam up to the centre back waist.

measurements.name: Sitting rise
measurements.description: From the waist to the chair, sitting down.
measurements.howTo: Sit on a firm flat chair and measure down the side from the waist to the seat.

measurements.name: Head circumference
measurements.description: Round the head.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the head above the ears, across the forehead.

measurements.name: Head length
measurements.description: From the chin to the top of the head.
measurements.howTo: Stand against a wall and measure from under the chin to the top of the head.

measurements.name: Head width
measurements.description: Straight across the head.
measurements.howTo: Measure straight across the widest part of the head, above the ears.

measurements.name: Hand length
measurements.description: From the wrist to the tip of the middle finger.
measurements.howTo: Lay the hand flat and measure from the wrist crease to the tip of the middle finger.

measurements.name: Palm width
measurements.description: Across the palm.
measurements.howTo: Lay the hand flat and measure across the knuckles, leaving out the thumb.

measurements.name: Hand circumference
measurements.description: Round the hand with the thumb tucked in.
measurements.howTo: Tuck the thumb into the palm and measure round the widest part of the hand.

measurements.name: Foot length
measurements.description: From the heel to the longest toe.
measurements.howTo: Stand on a sheet of paper and measure from the back of the heel to the longest toe.

measurements.name: Foot width
measurements.description: Across the widest part of the foot.
measurements.howTo: Stand on a sheet of paper and measure across the widest part of the foot.

measurements.name: Foot circumference
measurements.description: Round the widest part of the foot.
measurements.howTo: Measure round the ball of the foot at its widest.
